parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Students investigated the effect of light intensity on the surface area of leaves of soybean
plants.
• 100 soybean seeds were planted in pots and put into the shade (low light).
• 100 soybean seeds were planted in pots and put into full sun.
• The soybean seeds were allowed to germinate and grow for 30 days.
• After 30 days, three of the oldest leaves and three of the youngest leaves were removed
from each plant.
• The surface area of each of the removed leaves was measured.
